evidence: Supported in substance (no softening needed). https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-19/section-4.7 (b)(2): CBP must receive "for any vessel covered ... the CBP-approved electronic equivalent of the vessel's Cargo Declaration (CBP Form 1302), 24 hours before the cargo is laden aboard the vessel at the foreign port" (per-vessel declaration). Legacy CBP Trade Act vessel FAQ (copy at https://www.westpandi.com/globalassets/news/vessel_faq.doc, 'Diversion To A Foreign Port'): "Carriers will have to amend the previous bill indicating to CBP the change in vessel information. This cargo would have to once again comply with the 24-hour rule." CBP speaks of amending the bill with new vessel information, not a 'new AMS filing'; the draft does not say 'new filing'. Only the wording '다시 맞아야' is unnatural (맞춰야), and naming who amends is clearer.
fix: 모선이 바뀌거나 다음 배로 밀리면(roll-over) AMS를 보낸 선사나 NVOCC가 바뀐 선박 정보로 자료를 고쳐야 하고, 새 선박에 싣기 24시간 전 기한도 다시 지켜야 합니다.
